attchmntText: German Green Steel and Power Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
sm_name: German Green Steel and Power Limited
voiceSummary: German Green Steel and Power Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 1196.30 lakh rupees for the quarter and 2997.93 lakh rupees for the half year. Consolidated net profit after tax was 1686.22 lakh rupees for the quarter and 3849.93 lakh rupees for the half year. Earnings per share were 2.19 and 3.06 respectively. S.A.L. Steel Limited reported standalone net profit after tax of 10.41 crore rupees for the quarter and 13.51 crore rupees for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Anup Engineering Limited reported consolidated net profit after tax of 658.36 lakh rupees for the quarter and 715.38 lakh rupees for the half year. Samor Reality Limited reported a net loss after tax of 1.06 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
